description_en: Queries the usage details of a reserved instance (RI)

name: QueryRIUtilizationDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RI. If this parameter is left empty, the usage details of all RIs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 筛选查询的预留实例ID，为空时返回所有的使用的预留实例明细
parameters.name: ri_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the RI
parameters.name: instance_spec

parameters.help_en:
The code of the service to which the RI is applied. Default value: ecsRi. Valid values:

ecsRi: ECS RI.
scu_bag: storage capacity unit (SCU)
parameters.help_zh:
取值：
ecsRi（默认值）：ECS的预留实例。
scu_bag：存储容量单位包
parameters.name: ri_commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance whose fees are deducted by using the RI. If this parameter is left empty, the usage details of all instances are queried
parameters.help_zh: 被抵扣实例的ID，为空时返回所有实例的明细数据
parameters.name: deducted_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the RI was created. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the RI expires. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认为20，最大值为300
parameters.name: page_size
